title.en: Youth protests in Germany: calm day, violent night
title.sw: Maandamano ya vijana Ujerumani: mchana shwari, usiku vurugu

summary.en: Thousands of young people marched in over 30 German cities on Saturday. Organizers said 100,000 took part. The day was mostly peaceful, but in the evening there was violence in several cities.
summary.sw: Maelfu ya vijana waliandamana katika miji zaidi ya 30 ya Ujerumani Jumamosi. Waandaaji walisema watu 100,000 walishiriki. Mchana ulikuwa shwari kwa kiasi kikubwa, lakini jioni kulitokea vurugu katika miji kadhaa.

title.en: Berlin: left party says yes to coalition talks
title.sw: Berlin: chama cha Linke chakubali mazungumzo ya muungano

summary.en: Berlin's Left party voted by a clear majority for coalition talks with the Greens and the SPD. The talks should start on Monday, six weeks after the election.
summary.sw: Chama cha Linke Berlin kimepiga kura kwa wingi mkubwa kukubali mazungumzo ya muungano na Greens na SPD. Mazungumzo yanatarajiwa kuanza Jumatatu, wiki sita baada ya uchaguzi.

title.en: El Niño rains hit Mara Region
title.sw: Mvua za El Niño zaathiri Mkoa wa Mara

summary.en: One child died and more than 400 houses were damaged in Bunda and Rorya after El Niño rains. The regional commissioner told people in valleys and other risky areas to move.
summary.sw: Mtoto mmoja alifariki na nyumba zaidi ya 400 ziliharibiwa Bunda na Rorya baada ya mvua za El Niño. Mkuu wa mkoa aliwaambia watu wanaoishi mabondeni na maeneo hatarishi wahame.

title.en: Dar es Salaam may get a Metropolitan Authority
title.sw: Dar es Salaam huenda ikapata Mamlaka ya Jiji Kuu

summary.en: A deputy minister told Parliament on 29 October that the government is merging two technical studies into one plan. The authority would coordinate planning and transport across city councils. No deadline was given.
summary.sw: Naibu waziri aliliambia Bunge tarehe 29 Oktoba kwamba serikali inaunganisha tafiti mbili za kitaalamu kuwa mpango mmoja. Mamlaka hiyo ingeratibu mipango na usafiri kati ya halmashauri za jiji. Hakuna tarehe ya mwisho iliyotolewa.

summary.en: A fire overnight destroyed 10 rooms of a house in Kati Ward, Arusha. No one was hurt. Firefighters stopped it from reaching a nearby building with more than 20 families. A faulty gas cylinder is the first suspected cause.
summary.sw: Moto wa usiku uliteketeza vyumba 10 vya nyumba moja Kata ya Kati, Arusha. Hakuna aliyejeruhiwa. Wazima moto walizuia moto usifike jengo jirani lenye familia zaidi ya 20. Mtungi wa gesi wenye hitilafu unatuhumiwa kuwa chanzo cha awali.

question.sw: Sentensi ipi ya Kijerumani ni sahihi?

options.en: Heute regnet es viel. (It rains a lot today.)
options.sw: Heute regnet es viel. (Leo mvua inanyesha sana.)

explanation.en: B: Heute regnet es viel. In a German statement the verb is always in position 2. Heute is position 1, so regnet comes next, then es. The other two put the verb in position 3. For weather, German uses es: Es regnet (it rains), es schneit (it snows). Five words: der Regen = rain; regnen = to rain; das Wetter = weather; nass = wet; viel = a lot. Review: um + Uhr (Um zehn Uhr regnet es.) and kein/keine (Heute gibt es keine Sonne.). Emin: Mvua inanyesha sana leo. = It rains a lot today. This practice does not prove exam readiness.
explanation.sw: B: Heute regnet es viel. Katika sentensi ya kawaida ya Kijerumani, kitenzi huwa mahali pa pili. Heute ni mahali pa kwanza, kwa hiyo regnet inafuata, kisha es. Nyingine mbili zinaweka kitenzi mahali pa tatu. Kwa hali ya hewa Kijerumani hutumia es: Es regnet (mvua inanyesha), es schneit (theluji inanyesha). Maneno matano: der Regen = mvua; regnen = kunyesha (mvua); das Wetter = hali ya hewa; nass = -lowa; viel = nyingi/sana. Marudio: um + Uhr (Um zehn Uhr regnet es.) na kein/keine (Heute gibt es keine Sonne.). Emin: Mvua inanyesha sana leo. = It rains a lot today. Mazoezi haya hayathibitishi utayari wa mtihani.
